{'test_behavior': 'Test that fromJson throws JsonSyntaxException when EOFException occurs after successful peek (non-empty document).\nThe current implementation catches EOFException and returns null only if the document was empty (isEmpty flag true).\nFor non-empty documents, it should wrap EOFException in JsonSyntaxException.\n', 'test_name': 'testFromJsonEOFExceptionAfterPeekNotEmpty\n', 'test_code': '@Test(expected = JsonSyntaxException.class)\npublic void testFromJsonEOFExceptionAfterPeekNotEmpty() throws IOException {\n    Gson gson = new Gson();\n    // Reader that allows peek() to succeed but throws EOFException on actual read\n    Reader reader = new Reader() {\n        private int count = 0;\n        @Override\n        public int read(char[] cbuf, int off, int len) throws IOException {\n            if (count == 0) {\n                // Return \'[\' to make peek() succeed (start of array)\n                cbuf[off] = \'[\';\n                count++;\n                return 1;\n            }\n            throw new EOFException("Unexpected end of input");\n        }\n        @Override\n        public void close() throws IOException {}\n    };\n    JsonReader jsonReader = new JsonReader(reader);\n    // This should cause EOFException during reading, not during peek\n    // Since the document is non-empty (peek succeeded), it should throw JsonSyntaxException\n    gson.fromJson(jsonReader, String.class);\n}\n', 'new_imports_code': 'import java.io.EOFException;\nimport java.io.IOException;\nimport java.io.Reader;\nimport com.google.gson.stream.JsonReader;\nimport com.google.gson.JsonSyntaxException;\n'}
